It is the only measured recipe with demonstrated quality retention above the threshold; the lower-memory int3-g128 and mixed3-4-g128 trials scored 0.8 and 0.85. Recommend it as the best evidence-backed hypothesis, then falsify it by measuring quality and throughput against BF16 under the unchanged gates.
